object.attr: derived: CF-S15. A hand typo such as <descripton> loads as a missing value with no message. A validation error keeps the document usable, and the rewrite still keeps the content. Decided on 2026-11-10 (Q-S9): when a newer Mellon adds to the format, a team upgrades together.
object.description: If a data file holds an element or XML attribute that the on-disk format doesn't define, Mellon shall report a validation error naming the file and the element or attribute.
